items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: See, I joined Louie in June in Indianapolis.

ctx.x: Is this when Louie came back in the band -- opened at the Regal?
Well, no -- well, yeah, this was when he came back, but this was after I had joined Louie. See, I joined Louie in June in Indianapolis. That's where the Greystone Ballroom is, isn't it?
